craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 17. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 9. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Of one who entered into that, of disciples and of the guru also: these eleven are told as causes for presence.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatpraviṣṭasya kasyāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gurostathā ekādaśaite kathitāḥ saṃnidhānāya hetavaḥ
